name: Shishiodoshi
source:
You've arrived in Japan with the help of Peter Smith, the Silver Prince of the mythic people, and meet with Megumi, the enigmatic mythic familiar of the Bamboo Witch.

Now the trial of the 'Bamboo Path' awaits you, can you reach your destination without deviation...or will you be tempted to stray away? Fortune favours the bold, but keep your wits about you...or you may lose more than you bargained for.

Play as The Crooked Man's apprentice as you unravel the mysteries surrounding your mentor and encounter a world of Japanese culture, magic and mythics.   

[From [url=https://seraten04.itch.io/shishiodoshi]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
你在神话人民的银王子彼得·史密斯的帮助下抵达日本，并会见了竹女巫的神秘神话魔宠惠美。

现在，“竹道”的考验正在等待着你，你能否顺利到达目的地……还是会迷失方向？命运眷顾勇敢的人，但要保持理智……否则你的损失可能会超出你的预期。

扮演歪歪扭扭的人的学徒，解开围绕导师的谜团，并邂逅日本文化、魔法和神话的世界。

[来自[url=https://seraten04.itch.io/shishiodoshi]itch.io[/url]]
